note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of the WatchNation front photo (40.5 mm case, Orient USA; strap 20.5 / 20.4 mm measured against 21 mm). Heights before the house depth scale (11.8 mm thick listing, domed crystal; side photo from Ocarat for the dome). House method: modelled polished steel case, bezel, lugs and crown, polished steel hands and batons; the photo map serves only the dial print, the ORIENT letters and the black leather strap.

case.note: [kind, offset, z]: round rings about the pivot, 'case' = offset from the 40.5 mm case radius, 'crystal' = offset from the crystal opening (18.21 mm radius, inner edge of the polished bezel in the photo). Flank, rounded shoulder, polished bezel rising inward to the crystal seat, inner lip

lug.note: one lug, mirrored to all four: tip, inner edge and outer offset by depth below the tip from the trace (mean of the four photo lugs); top slopes down to the tip

rehaut.note: polished ring from the dial edge (16.85 mm) up to the crystal seat: the bright band inside the bezel in the photo

crystal.note: high domed crystal (Bambino): straight wall to 8.6 mm, dome to 11.6 mm at the centre (11.8 mm listed thickness)

dial.note: flat dial to the dial edge; minute track, sub-dials, date and print in the photo map

applied.note: batons: polished steel plates from the photo outlines; ORIENT letters: raised plates with the photo on them

hands.note: rectangular (Bauhaus) hour and minute with square ends, seconds needle with a straight tail, ridge on the tip-tail axis: polished steel (photo)

crown.note: fluted crown on the 3 o'clock axis: 4.7 mm across, 2.6 mm from the case flank (photo)

strap.note: 21 mm smooth black leather, house curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips, 7 mm radius, end = tip + 2.2 x radius; starts under the case. UVs from the photo's straight strap: the case edge on the centre line (trace strap_mm case_y) to photo_past_tip past the lug tip, folded back and forth

steel_polished.note: house polished steel: case, bezel, rehaut, lugs, crown, hands and batons

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
